_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Denial (32-38); coil statistics demand HOLD as the graded, honest call—directional guesses here are 0-for-18 in this regime.
next_move.brains_agree: NO—analyst calls HOLD/Denial with explicit coil logic; narrative calls implied LONG via 'mean-reversion rally' with Disbelief/Hope framing. Trust-weighted reconciliation favors analyst.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain above 30 for 2+ readings AND btc_momentum_30d breaks above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: funding turns negative AND exchange_netflow drops below 80 (sudden outflow = positioning shift)
